free_tier.stated: keyless; pools upstream GitHub tokens, so no caller key is needed

per_object_cap.stated: code search 10 requests a minute; search 30 a minute; core 5,000 an hour

interface_detail: a GitHub REST proxy; no published contract
chaining: The only way to read GitHub code without a token; `gh search code` is the fallback, not the primary

limits.value: code search 10 a minute, search 30 a minute, core 5,000 an hour, from x-ratelimit-limit
420 with a zero byte body for /user, /emojis, /licenses, /meta, /graphql and any unknown path

reliability_note: 420 on 5 of 10 paths tried; every proxied path answered

evidence.proved: 420 with 0 bytes; the same for /emojis, /licenses, /meta and /graphql
404 with a 106-byte GitHub JSON body, so a routing miss and a real 404 look alike until the body is read

notes: Code search works, which the repository's own orientation file says it does not. GraphQL does not, so discussions are unreachable. The 420 is a path decision, not a rate limit.
